user.title: WyreStorm NetworkHD Controller
user.description: Enter the SSH connection details for your WyreStorm NetworkHD controller.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your NetworkHD controller
data_description.username: SSH username for the controller (default: wyrestorm)
data_description.password: SSH password for the controller (default: networkhd)
data_description.host_key_fingerprint: Pins the controller's SSH key so Home Assistant only sends the credentials to that controller. Get it with `ssh-keyscan -p 10022 CONTROLLER_IP | ssh-keygen -lf -` and paste the SHA256 line(s); several are allowed. Leave empty to trust the key the controller presents now (you are asked to confirm it).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WyreStorm NetworkHD
reconfigure.description: Update the SSH connection details for your WyreStorm NetworkHD controller.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your NetworkHD controller
data_description.password: SSH password for the controller; leave empty to keep the current one
data_description.host_key_fingerprint: Pins the controller's SSH key so Home Assistant only sends the credentials to that controller. Get it with `ssh-keyscan -p 10022 CONTROLLER_IP | ssh-keygen -lf -` and paste the SHA256 line(s); several are allowed. Leave empty to trust the key the controller presents now (you are asked to confirm it).

zeroconf_confirm.title: WyreStorm NetworkHD controller found
zeroconf_confirm.description: A NetworkHD controller was found at {host}. Enter its SSH connection details to add it.

data_description.username: SSH username for the controller (default: wyrestorm)
data_description.password: SSH password for the controller (default: networkhd)
data_description.host_key_fingerprint: Pins the controller's SSH key so Home Assistant only sends the credentials to that controller. Get it with `ssh-keyscan -p 10022 CONTROLLER_IP | ssh-keygen -lf -` and paste the SHA256 line(s); several are allowed. Leave empty to trust the key the controller presents now (you are asked to confirm it).

confirm_host_key.title: Trust this controller?
confirm_host_key.description: The controller identified itself with SSH host key `{fingerprint}`. Confirm to trust this controller from now on: Home Assistant will refuse to connect, and will not send the credentials, if the key changes. You can change it later with Reconfigure.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate WyreStorm NetworkHD
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {host} rejected the stored SSH credentials. Enter the current ones.

error.invalid_host_key_fingerprint: Not a valid SSH host key fingerprint; expected SHA256:... as printed by ssh-keygen -lf
error.host_key_mismatch: The controller presented a different SSH host key ({fingerprint}) than the pinned fingerprint, so no credentials were sent. If you expect this (controller replaced or reset), enter this fingerprint instead; otherwise check that the device at this address is your controller.
error.host_key_mismatch_reauth: The controller presented a different SSH host key ({fingerprint}) than the pinned fingerprint, so no credentials were sent. If you expect this (controller replaced or reset), use Reconfigure on the integration entry to accept the new key; otherwise check that the device at this address is your controller.

abort.no_mac: The discovered controller did not announce its MAC address
abort.wrong_device: The controller at the new host is a different controller (another MAC address). Add it as a new integration entry instead.

host_key_mismatch.title: NetworkHD controller SSH host key changed
host_key_mismatch.description: The controller at {host} presented SSH host key `{fingerprint}`, which does not match the pinned fingerprint, so Home Assistant did not connect or send the credentials. If the controller was replaced or reset, open the integration, choose Reconfigure and enter this fingerprint (or clear the field to confirm the new key). Otherwise check that nothing else is answering at this address.
